decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an early multi-axis transient with partial recovery and ambiguous cross-axis behavior (~370–510), and (2) the onset of a strong, sustained trend with possible superposed opposing signal near 620–625 (~570–630). Other intervals show mostly smooth trends or ordinary noise.

regions.observation: N/E/U show correlated multi-sample drop (~370–385) followed by a partial, noisy recovery; E and U exhibit opposing rebounds around 400–410, suggesting possible superposed motion or offset with ambiguous return. The shape is not smooth noise nor a single jump.

Clear sustained monotonic trend onset in all axes starting ~570, accelerating after ~600; U drops sharply while N and E rise steadily—suggesting platform-like motion. A possible opposing transient appears near 620–625 (U briefly flattens/rises while N/E continue up), hinting at superposed change or measurement artifact.
